    The Senior Finance Manager – Financial Reporting leads the Group’s financial reporting function across RISE PH, Synacy, and affiliated entities. Reporting to the Group Financial Controller, the role owns the month-end close, consolidation, and statutory reporting cycle for a multi-entity, multi-jurisdiction digital infrastructure and internet service provider (ISP) group. He/she ensures that financial statements are accurate, timely, PFRS/IFRS-compliant, and audit-ready, and supports the statutory audit led by the Group’s audit manager.

    This is a senior management role within the Finance team, positioned directly below the Group Financial Controller and accountable for the quality of the Group’s reported numbers, the strength of reporting controls, and the development of the financial reporting team.

    Duties and responsibilities

    Financial reporting and consolidation

    • Own the monthly, quarterly, and annual close for all Group entities, delivering the close within agreed timelines
    • Prepare and review consolidated and entity-level financial statements (statement of financial position, P&L, cash flows, changes in equity) and accompanying notes and schedules
    • Lead group consolidation, including intercompany eliminations, foreign currency translation, and reconciliation of intercompany balances across entities and jurisdictions
    • Prepare management reporting packages, with quantified variance commentary against budget, forecast, and prior periods
    • Interpret and apply new or amended PFRS/IFRS standards, prepare technical accounting position papers, and assess their impact on the Group
    • Review intercompany billing and cost-plus arrangements for correct accounting, VAT, and withholding tax treatment, in coordination with the Tax team

    Digital infrastructure / ISP accounting

    • Apply PFRS 15 to subscriber, enterprise, wholesale, and bundled service revenue, including installation fees, promos, and contract assets/liabilities
    • Apply PFRS 16 to network-related leases (pole attachments, tower and site leases, IRU/dark fibre, office and warehouse leases)
    • Oversee accounting for network CAPEX: capitalisation of fibre build, construction-in-progress, CPE, and network equipment; useful-life reviews, impairment testing, and asset retirement
    • Ensure GL-to-subledger reconciliation of fixed assets and CPE inventory across regional warehouses

    Audit support, controls, and governance

    • Support the statutory audit led by the Group’s audit manager by providing timely, complete financial reporting deliverables and resolving reporting-related audit queries
    • Prepare financial statement schedules, reconciliations, and PBC items within the financial reporting scope; address audit adjustments affecting the financial statements
    • Implement corrective actions on management letter points relating to financial reporting
    • Design, document, and maintain internal controls over financial reporting, including review controls, segregation of duties, and close checklists
    • Support internal audit, due diligence, lender, and investor reporting requirements as needed

    Multi-jurisdiction compliance

    • Ensure timely and accurate statutory reporting to the SEC (AFS, GIS), BIR, and other regulators, including PEZA/BOI where applicable
    • Coordinate reporting requirements across Group entities, regional branches, and foreign affiliates or counterparts, including group reporting packs prepared under different local requirements
    • Support regulatory reporting to the National Telecommunications Commission (NTC) and other industry bodies, where financial data is required
    • Monitor regulatory and accounting developments across jurisdictions and advise the Group Financial Controller on their impact

    Leadership and process improvement

    • Lead, coach, and develop the financial reporting team; set goals, review work, and manage performance
    • Drive close automation, ERP optimisation, and reporting process improvements to shorten the close cycle and improve accuracy
    • Partner with FP&A, Tax, Treasury, Billing, Network/Engineering, and Procurement to ensure complete and accurate financial data
    • Provide ad hoc analysis and reports to the Group Financial Controller and senior management

    The RISE mission is to Accelerate Internet for the Philippines - we do this by focusing on the overall customer experience; providing excellent internet services while creating a positive impact on our partners and their industries.

We also operate Open Access Network, a Fiber as a Service offering that helps reduce complexity for developers and telecommunication companies while increasing customer satisfaction.
